patterns.note: Content is primarily centered with generous vertical spacing between distinct sections, often featuring full-width imagery or a two-column split for information blocks.
A strong contrast between elegant, large serif headings and smaller, clean sans-serif body text creates a sophisticated and readable hierarchy.
A rich, deep brown/burgundy is used as a dominant background color for the hero and age gate, contrasted with warm off-white backgrounds for content sections and dark text.

Sections and individual content elements (images, text blocks) are expected to reveal with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as they scroll into the viewport, creating a smooth, engaging browsing experience.
Sections are clearly delineated by full-bleed photography, distinct background colors, or prominent typographic headings, guiding the user through different content themes.

technique_notes: A full-screen age gate modal with a semi-transparent dark overlay appears on initial load, requiring user interaction before the main content is accessible.

The site uses a smooth scrolling library (locomotive-scroll) to enhance the user's scroll experience, likely coupled with scroll-triggered animations that reveal content elements with a staggered fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport.
Hero and key visual sections utilize high-quality, full-bleed photography to establish mood and brand identity, often paired with minimal text overlays.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant, oversized serif hero text (~4-5x body) with large, refined serif section headings, complemented by smaller, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with most elements and images featuring crisp, unrounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, particularly in the hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of luxury and allowing elements to breathe.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a prominent, full-screen age gate immediately sets a sophisticated and exclusive tone. This, combined with the elegant serif typography and rich, deep color palette, creates an atmosphere of refined luxury and curated experience, rather than a typical e-commerce or hospitality site.
